project.name: Budget Tracker - WBS Task & Progress Manager
project.description: WBS-like task management web app with planned/actual tracking, progress visualization, and delay warnings
project.architecture: Node.js + Express + SQLite + Vanilla JS (Conservative/Monolithic MVC)

tasks.name: API Specification & Data Model Definition
tasks.description: Define RESTful API endpoints, request/response schemas, and SQLite database schema with indexes

tasks.name: Project Scaffolding & Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize Node.js project, install dependencies, configure Express, setup directory structure

tasks.name: Database Layer Implementation
tasks.description: Implement SQLite connection, schema creation, migration system, and base model classes using better-sqlite3

tasks.name: Task Model Implementation
tasks.description: Implement Task model with CRUD operations, hierarchy queries (parent/children), soft delete, and sort order

tasks.name: Actual Model Implementation
tasks.description: Implement Actual model with daily recording (upsert), cumulative queries, and date-based filtering

tasks.name: Progress & Delay Calculation Service
tasks.description: Implement progressService with auto-progress calculation, parent aggregation, delay detection, and warning thresholds

tasks.name: Task Service Layer
tasks.description: Business logic for task CRUD, cascading operations, validation, and progress integration

tasks.name: Actual Service Layer
tasks.description: Business logic for daily actual recording, upsert handling, and progress recalculation trigger

tasks.name: Task API Routes & Controller
tasks.description: Implement REST endpoints for tasks: GET list, GET by ID, GET children, POST create, PUT update, DELETE soft-delete, PUT reorder

tasks.name: Actual API Routes & Controller
tasks.description: Implement REST endpoints for actuals: GET by task, POST record, PUT update, DELETE remove

tasks.name: Dashboard Service & API
tasks.description: Implement dashboard summary statistics: total tasks, completion rate, delay count, overall progress

tasks.name: Input Validation & Sanitization Middleware
tasks.description: Server-side validation for all inputs, XSS sanitization, error formatting middleware

tasks.name: LAN Network Configuration
tasks.description: Implement 0.0.0.0 binding, local IP detection, CORS configuration for LAN access

tasks.name: CSS Design System & Layout
tasks.description: Create CSS variables, base layout, responsive grid, status colors, progress bar styles, gray-out completed styles

tasks.name: Dashboard Page UI
tasks.description: Frontend dashboard with summary widgets, overall progress chart, delay alerts panel

tasks.name: API Client Module
tasks.description: Fetch API wrapper with error handling, loading states, and response parsing

tasks.name: Task List & Drill-Down UI
tasks.description: Major items grid, drill-down navigation, breadcrumb, task rows with progress bars, status badges, color-coded dates

tasks.name: Task Create/Edit Form UI
tasks.description: Modal dialog for task creation, inline editing for task properties, date pickers, validation feedback

tasks.name: Daily Actual Input UI
tasks.description: Form for recording daily actuals per task, history view, cumulative summary display

tasks.name: Search & Filter UI
tasks.description: Search bar, status filter, date range filter, result highlighting

tasks.name: Warning & Notification System UI
tasks.description: Toast notifications for save/error feedback, delay warning badges, visual alert indicators
tasks.output: public/js/components/toast.js, warning indicators in task rows

tasks.name: Unit Tests - Models
tasks.description: Jest tests for taskModel and actualModel: CRUD operations, hierarchy queries, constraints

tasks.name: Unit Tests - Services
tasks.description: Jest tests for progressService, taskService, actualService: calculation accuracy, edge cases, cascading

tasks.name: Integration Tests - API
tasks.description: Supertest integration tests for all API endpoints: happy path, error cases, validation

tasks.name: E2E Integration - Frontend+Backend
tasks.description: End-to-end flow testing: create task hierarchy, input actuals, verify progress calculation, check delay warnings

tasks.name: Performance Optimization
tasks.description: SQLite query optimization (indexes, query plans), frontend bundle review, lazy loading assessment

tasks.name: Security Review & Hardening
tasks.description: Verify XSS prevention, SQL injection protection, Helmet configuration, input sanitization completeness

tasks.name: Responsive Design Verification
tasks.description: Test tablet/desktop layouts, touch targets, font sizing at different viewports

tasks.name: Documentation & README
tasks.description: Generate README.md, about.html, usage guide, launch_app.command

tasks.name: Final Review & Polish
tasks.description: Final pass on UX, error messages, edge cases, code cleanup, console.log removal

milestones.name: Design & Setup Complete
milestones.criteria: API spec and database schema defined, project scaffold ready

milestones.name: Backend Core Complete
milestones.criteria: All API endpoints functional, database operations verified

milestones.name: Frontend Complete
milestones.criteria: All pages functional, progress/delay visualization working

milestones.name: Testing Complete
milestones.criteria: All tests passing, 80%+ coverage on business logic

milestones.name: Quality & Delivery Complete
milestones.criteria: Performance optimized, security verified, documentation ready

step_1.description: API spec + project scaffolding in parallel

step_2.description: Database layer + LAN config + CSS design system in parallel

step_3.description: Task model + Actual model in parallel

step_4.description: Progress/delay calculation (critical, depends on both models)

step_5.description: Task service + Actual service + Model unit tests in parallel

step_6.description: API routes + API client in parallel

step_7.description: Validation middleware + Dashboard UI + Task list UI + Service tests in parallel

step_8.description: Task form + Actual form + Search + Warnings + Integration tests in parallel
